property_summary: Rule: in any block number divisible by 15, a correctly-funded call to fallback against a cooperative payee completes and pays out the full balance, leaving address(c).balance == 0; the mutant sets pastBlockTime after the payout, so a payee that checks c.pastBlockTime() during the transfer sees the stale timestamp, reverts, and the whole call reverts leaving c.balance == 10 ether.
change_summary: Move the pastBlockTime update to after the conditional payout so the payout executes before the timestamp is recorded (observable when the transfer reverts vs. when state updates matter across calls).
